findings.title: Shared-infrastructure outcomes are judged against the acceptance case's expected result code rather than the block's unblock criterion
evidence: src/ucm/pippi_work_units.py assess_work_unit_outcome: matched = observed_result_code == case['expected_result_code'] for both work classes; the infrastructure block (unblock_criterion) is not consulted

tier2/work-selection/work-selection-check.json: infra step reporting the case code 'PASS' -> PREREQUISITE_SATISFIED_FOLLOW_ON_DIRECT_STEP_REQUIRED; infra step reporting the block's unblock criterion 'X_PASS' -> PREREQUISITE_UNMET; acceptance_case_closed false in both
findings.effect: Prerequisite semantics are conflated with the acceptance case's; the never-closes invariant is unaffected.
findings.repair: For SHARED_INFRASTRUCTURE compare against the bound block's unblock_criterion (or a declared prerequisite result code) and record the infrastructure_block_root in the outcome.
